name: Submit Tribe registration
description: Verifies the main community registration workflow reaches confirmation.
steps: Enter valid name, email, WhatsApp and city
expected: Registration confirmation is shown without a false success state.

name: Create, publish, edit and delete CMS content
description: Verifies a new CMS record can complete the full lifecycle and deletion persists after refresh.
setup: Sign in to the CMS with the administrator account
steps: Create a unique QA City location
Edit its description and publish again
expected: QA City is created, published, updated, and then permanently absent after deletion.

name: Edit and publish a CMS page
description: Verifies an existing page can be changed and the published version is used by the live page.
setup: Sign in to the CMS with the administrator account
steps: Change the page title to a unique test title
Return to the CMS and refresh
expected: The public Locations page shows the new title and the CMS retains one canonical Locations page record.

name: Manage Stories and contact links
description: Verifies the remaining content collection and contact destinations remain independently editable.
setup: Sign in to the CMS with the administrator account
steps: Open Stories / Journal and edit a story
Verify Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok, Email URL and Join URL are separate fields
expected: The story publishes successfully and each contact destination remains independently editable.

name: Handle CMS write failures visibly
description: Verifies a failed backend write is shown to the administrator without deleting existing content.
setup: Sign in to the CMS with the administrator account
expected: A visible error is shown and existing CMS content remains available.
